task: Find a genuinely different, simple complete human writing convention that pays for open content and boundaries and is not inherently limited to three medial working signs.
access: Live route, composition topic, bounded search/show/duplicates/route-check and claim-bearing earlier reports. No manuscript query/image, source counts, new corpus, executed encoder, target values, root experiment output or shared root-file changes.
decision: No genuinely new complete survivor was found in this bounded review. IDEA000935 is the clearest already specified teachable full-word writer with possible large interior diversity. Its forward rule is complete on its declared symbolic input, but its existing fixed-source frequency constraint and literal teaching-key problems are retained. Its unreviewed registry label must not make it a fresh next experiment. No new RAW card is added.

strongest_existing_complete_contract.origin: Explicitly invented teaching procedure, no claimed medieval attestation. It differs from1193's fragment tree and three medial signs; it is not an enlargement or recoloring of that table.
strongest_existing_complete_contract.human_rule: Copy each source word left-to-right. Use the longest of sixteen fixed exact substring shortcuts whenever present; otherwise spell the next character. Preserve source spaces and paragraph boundaries. A shortcut consists of r plus one selector. The reader expands these fixed literal strings and the ordinary character codes, then can check the mandatory greedy choice. Unknown ordinary words use the same spelling scan.
strongest_existing_complete_contract.alphabet_and_cost: Nineteen source letters have single working signs; t-z have q plus one selector. Fifty-six explicitly listed uppercase, punctuation and other characters have y plus two selectors. The reader learns26 lowercase entries,56 rare entries,16 exact shortcuts and their reserved-prefix syntax. No whole-word or whole-clause dictionary is learned. Language vocabulary and spelling are still assumed. Characters outside the declared82-character input inventory cause explicit failure rather than deletion.
strongest_existing_complete_contract.meaning_and_memory: The preserved ordinary source language supplies meaning, including negation and unresolved pronouns. No previous-word, paragraph-number or counter memory changes a character's value. Directly repeated source words produce the same complete group twice; no mandatory common repeat header is introduced.

complete_hand_example.reading: The first group spells n-i-m-m; the second e-s; r followed by selector ch expands to the fixed shortcut nicht. The source command and its unresolved es survive. These are the card's artificial teaching values, not native word meanings; the displayed array commas are explanatory and not written extra signs.
complete_hand_example.overlap_counterexample: einen must use its one longest shortcut; shortcut(ein)+spell(en) is decodable but noncanonical and must be rejected. Shortcuts cannot cross a source space.

long_interior_example.scope: A new hand calculation from the already fixed table, not a corpus sample, source-statistical run, native key claim or fit.
long_interior_example.manual_trace: h=l,a=a,n=ch,d=i,w=q+i,e=n,r=cph,k=t,s=cfh,z=q+s,e=n,u=q+o,g=s. None of the sixteen fixed shortcut strings is consumed in this word.
long_interior_example.consequence: This legal sixteen-sign teaching word has ten distinct working-sign types after removing its first and last sign. Thus large possible interior diversity does not require another1193-style alphabet expansion or a hidden source-word table. It does not show matching native shape, length, frequency or q/y behavior.

strongest_existing_complete_contract.physical_completion_limit: The raw rule permits line wraps only between complete groups, yet declares no maximum word width or visible continuation rule for an overwide unknown word. It is a complete symbolic word transducer for its input inventory, not a fully specified fixed-page handwriting protocol for arbitrarily long names. Do not silently introduce split markers, shrink letters or infer a native line-wrap convention. Ordinary full spelling also pays the complete length of long unknown words.
strongest_existing_complete_contract.known_literal_shape_limit: Every complete token unit ends in one of the nineteen ordinary selectors; q,r,y are reserved prefixes and cannot be final under the unchanged literal teaching assignment. The known final-y problem is therefore retained, not overcome by the long-interior example. This statement concerns this toy assignment; no new claim excluding every bijective renaming is made.
strongest_existing_complete_contract.existing_frequency_limit: One fixed injective spelling per source token preserves all token equalities. GDT1202's unchanged four-source bound already excludes even two forms per whole source token under the old necessary screen, hence also this one-form contract on those same projections. No new carrier or shortcut optimization changes that conditional fact. This does not refute every possible source language.
strongest_existing_complete_contract.exact_followup_distinction: GDT1179A actually used this literal shorthand with a different short-word pairing rule and paid inner boundaries; it failed the full inherited screen. Do not say that1179A executed935's unchanged one-source-word/one-group contract. That contract's fixed-source exclusion follows from1202 instead.

conclusion: The useful constructive result is narrow: simple spelling-plus-paid-shortcuts already permits meaningful open words, direct repetitions and many interior signs. The challenge is its complete conjunction of source grouping, word distribution, boundary treatment and literal shape constraints. The current1193 three-medial-sign exclusion must not be generalized to all hand-usable writers, while935 must not be promoted merely because it avoids that one exclusion. No next candidate is selected here and no calibration result is anticipated.
